name: Umit Bozdag
title: Senior Operations Manager
whatsappText: Hi Umit, I found you on umitbozdag.com —
statement: I make large exhibitions and conferences run on time, on budget and safely.
intro: I’m Umit — a senior operations manager who has spent 14 years putting on exhibitions and conferences. Since 2012 I’ve worked on 25 shows in 9 countries: from the Türkiye pavilion at World Travel Market to Gastech in Milan, Breakbulk in Rotterdam and Houston, and now UK Construction Week and Futurebuild at ExCeL London.

My job is the practical side of a show — budgets, suppliers, venues, floorplans, health & safety and everything on site — so the organiser’s team can focus on exhibitors and visitors. I also build small digital tools and AI workflows that make the work faster.

servicesIntro: Everything that has to happen for a show to open on time, on budget and safely.

services.title: Show operations, end to end
services.text: Venue contracting, build-up, live days and breakdown — often across several shows at once, in London and abroad.

services.title: Budgets & suppliers
services.text: Operational budgets built with directors and held to the final reconciliation; tendering and negotiating with suppliers worldwide.

services.title: Venues, floorplans & compliance
services.text: Venue liaison and floorplan compliance with venue and local regulations — ExCeL, Olympia, the NEC, Fiera Milano, Rotterdam Ahoy and more.

services.title: Health & safety
services.text: IOSH Safe Management at Live Events: risk control, monitoring and safe working on the show floor.

services.title: Onsite services & staffing
services.text: Catering, cleaning, security, temporary staffing, signage and wayfinding, internet and power.

services.title: Sponsorship, features & digital tools
services.text: Sponsor deliverables and feature areas built to spec and budget, plus in-house tools and AI workflows that speed up delivery.

shows.name: World LNG Summit & Awards 2025
shows.role: Operations Manager — operations support and ministerial liaison
shows.summary: The 25th World LNG Summit & Awards, hosted by BOTAŞ and held in Türkiye for the first time, brought around 1,000 senior attendees and 120 speakers from across the LNG industry to Istanbul. As a native Turkish speaker, I was asked to support the operations team and to be the main point of contact for the team of Alparslan Bayraktar, Türkiye’s Minister of Energy and Natural Resources, making sure the Minister’s attendance ran smoothly and followed ministerial protocol.

Planning the Minister’s attendance and following ministerial protocol on the day
Turkish-language liaison between the operations team, the host BOTAŞ and local partners
Supporting the operations lead across the summit
Venue liaison with the Shangri-La Bosphorus, meeting rooms and catering
